class S {
  private static final Map<String, Long> A = new ConcurrentHashMap<String, Long>();
  private static final Map<String, Long> B = new ConcurrentHashMap<String, Long>();
  private static final Map<String, Long> C = new ConcurrentHashMap<String, Long>();
  void started() {
    Clock.schedulePeriodically(this, BRelTime.makeMinutes(1), purge, null);
  }
  public void doPurge() {
    C.remove("x");
  }
  void a(String id) {
    A.entrySet().removeIf(e -> e.getValue() < now());
    A.put(id, now());
  }
  void b(String id) {
    for (Iterator<String> it = B.keySet().iterator(); it.hasNext();) { if (old(it.next())) it.remove(); }
    B.put(id, now());
  }
  void c(String id) {
    C.put(id, now());
  }
}
